method: lemma + local syntax + discourse function + parallel check + Vietnamese/English risk; no one-gloss rule

core_functions: sense-specific consciousness arising dependent on faculty and object
risks: Vietnamese 'thức' can sound like a persisting entity
English 'consciousness' can invite a permanent witness model
do not assume one unchanged consciousness transmigrates
cards.working_rule: Translate as 'thức/consciousness' but explicitly mark its condition-dependent mode and local type when relevant; never treat the lemma itself as proof of a soul-like carrier.

core_functions: context-specific bodily/verbal/mental processes in some texts
risks: aggregate and dependent-origination uses should not be assumed identical in every nuance
later Abhidhamma taxonomy should not be silently imported
cards.working_rule: Preserve saṅkhāra in technical analysis; select 'hành/choices/formations/fabrication' only after identifying the specific syntactic and doctrinal role.

core_functions: process linked to perception/thought and conflict
causal role more secure than any single dictionary gloss
risks: commentarial equation with craving/conceit/views may be useful but is not a simple lexical definition
Vietnamese 'hý luận' may sound merely like verbal debate
cards.working_rule: Keep papañca when precision matters; explain the observed causal function—elaborative/objectifying mental proliferation that feeds conflict—before choosing a gloss.

core_functions: continuity of attention in contemplative practice
path factor coordinated with view and effort
risks: modern 'nonjudgmental present awareness' is too narrow
Vietnamese 'niệm' may be opaque without functional explanation
memory sense must not erase active contemplative monitoring
cards.working_rule: Use 'niệm/mindfulness' but preserve the keeping-in-mind/continuity function; in path contexts include active monitoring guided by right view and effort.

core_functions: right samādhi in the eightfold path often specified through jhāna
broader meditative collected states in other contexts
risks: 'immersion' may over-associate every samādhi with full absorption
cards.working_rule: Prefer context label: 'định/collectedness/immersion'; when the text explicitly defines sammā-samādhi by jhānas, say so; do not universalize that exact definition to every samādhi occurrence.

core_functions: described as unconditioned in SN 43 material
risks: a single English metaphysical noun can prejudge ontology
'extinction' can be misread as annihilation of a self
cards.working_rule: Keep 'Nibbāna/Niết-bàn' in contested metaphysical contexts; first state textual functions (cessation, dispassion, release, unconditioned terminology) before offering any ontology.

invariant: No translation card may erase contextual variation or convert a preferred gloss into a doctrinal proof.
